newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM adds Japanese destinations to network.
newsitem.headline: KLM adds Japanese destinations to network.

text.p: Flag carrier KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Wednesday it would add scheduled flights to the Japanese airports of Sapporo and Nagoya to its network.

From the start of KLM's winter schedule on October 28, KLM will operate a twice-per-week service between Amsterdam and the two new destinations. It will use Boeing 747-400 aircraft seating 424 passengers and with cargo capacity of 15 tonnes.
The new service will increase the weekly number of KLM's scheduled flights to Japan to 14. It already operates a daily service between Amsterdam and Osaka and a five-per-week flight to Tokyo.
KLM said it will be the first European carrier to operate a direct service between Europe and Sapporo.
